summary: This class models Windows accessibility interactions for HP app testing. It extends HPXRebrandingFlow and provides methods for navigating Windows UI elements including Start menu, taskbar, Microsoft Store, and app settings. Uses Page Object Model pattern with driver-based element interactions (wait, click, hover, scroll). Includes state management for Windows overlays and verification methods for app icon visibility and pinning status.
